text: Maya (Design): quick thread / question: we9re reworking the account creation form in the console. two competing ideas: (A) inline validation (show error text under field) + a subtle asterisk for required; (B) no asterisk, put "required" inside the label or as microcopy. also: on mobile we have very tight real estate. thoughts on prioritizing clarity vs density? Omar (Eng): my vote is inline errors + programmatic required state. performance wise both are fine. prefer asterisk visually because it9s compact. but make sure the asterisk meets contrast requirements or has sr-only text for screen readers. Jules (Accessibility): asterisk alone is not enough for assistive tech. if you rely on asterisk, include visible text for screen readers: `required`. for inline errors use `role="alert"` and `aria-describedby` pointing to the error. avoid putting "required" inside placeholder text (bad for a11y). Rory (Product): also consider support volume. internal data shows users get confused when requiredness is hidden; small spike in tickets with the compact layout last quarter. could we AB test asterisk vs explicit "required" wording? Maya (Design): idea: default asterisk for desktop, explicit "required" string for enterprise theme and mobile where we can stack label + meta. for ultra-dense table rows, drop both and show inline microcopy only after a validation attempt (degraded affordance until error). Omar (Eng): implementation note: toggling label verbosity via CSS token is cheap. we can add a class `form-required--word` vs `form-required--asterisk`. AB test flag `ui.form.required_verbosity`. Jules (Accessibility): if you delay showing required meta until after submit on dense rows, make sure the first error field receives focus and the summary is announced. Use `aria-live="assertive"` for the top summary. Otherwise keyboard users can get lost. Rory (Product): sounds good. one more ask: destructive confirm patterns in the same page — are we OK with inline toast confirmations or do we need modal confirmations with an explicit checkbox for pool deletes? Maya (Design): for low-risk deletes (remove member) use undo-toasts. for high-risk (delete dataset, remove workspace) use modal + typed confirmation. modal should include a brief rationale and an opt-in checkbox if we think users need extra pause. Omar (Eng): agree. ensure modals are not just visually hidden but trap focus. add `data-confirm-kind` for telemetry: `undo|modal|typed`. Jules (Accessibility): typed confirmations are fine but make sure the input has `aria-label` and that mistakes are surfaced with clear, descriptive error text (not generic "invalid"). Also ensure the modal's heading is programmatically an `h2` and announced. QA-Bot: Quick checklist added to ticket: `a11y: form-required-announcement`, `telemetry: form.required_verbosity`, `ux: confirm-patterns-matrix`. Maya (Design): action items: i9ll produce 3 comps: desktop asterisk, mobile worded label, dense-row delayed-hint. Omar to add flag and a11y hooks. Jules to run a quick SR pass on the comps. Rory to approve AB test criteria. Rory (Product): ok will review AB metrics (error rate, support volume) and sign off. Omar (Eng): noted. i9ll stub the feature flag on staging. Jules (Accessibility): ping me when comps are up, will test VoiceOver+NVDA. Maya (Design): thanks all 1; closing after comps upload later today :ship:
